Method of Attack: First-stage backdoor deployment (Skipper) followed by second-stage backdoor installation (Carbon or Kazuar)
Encrypted tasks received from C&C server executed on infected or network machines
Use of encrypted container to store malware components and configuration
Use of compromised legitimate websites (mostly WordPress CMS) as first layer proxy for C&C servers
Injection into target processes to communicate with C&C server
Impacted Systems: Computers at embassies in Southeast Europe
Computers at embassies in former Soviet states
Computers at embassies in some South American countries
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted list of C&C servers embedded in Gazer’s PE resources
Compromised legitimate websites mostly using WordPress CMS acting as proxy
